text_block_list.text:
During some volunteer work, I was playing 
with children from a nearby kindergarten, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll catch you in no time~!

Super Creek deftly chases after the 
children as they dart swiftly around the 
playground equipment. Howeverâ

Super Creek slammed her head hard against 
the playground equipment and crouched down 
in pain.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That really startled me just 
now~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The moment we collided, sparks 
flashed before my eyes and it took me by 
surprise, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
After that, my head felt surprisingly 
clear, and running somehow felt so easy—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Could it be... that running style can 
be applied to racing?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, may I go back to the academy to 
check?
choice_data_list: Are you trying to hit your head again!?
Are you trying to bump your head again!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, not quite~. I'm just going to try 
running once more.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If this goes well, maybe I can make 
Trainer smile even more than now...♪

"Having gained something after bumping her 
head, Super Creek's running was 
dramatically sharpened from that day 
forward...!"
